root_cause.text: The function `find_empty_iaa_compression_mode` returns the loop boundary value `IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX` instead of an error when no empty slot is found, causing an out-of-bounds array access.
root_cause.evidence: The original loop `for (i = 0; i < IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX; i++) { ... } return i;` returns `IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX` when all slots are occupied; the patch changes the return to `-EINVAL` for that case.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The function `find_empty_iaa_compression_mode` returns the loop boundary value `IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX` instead of an error when no empty slot is found, causing an out-of-bounds array access.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The original loop `for (i = 0; i < IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX; i++) { ... } return i;` returns `IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX` when all slots are occupied; the patch changes the return to `-EINVAL` for that case.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect return value when no empty compression mode slot is available, ensuring a proper error code is returned.
intent_record.what: Refactored `find_empty_iaa_compression_mode()`: removed initial assignment of `i = -EINVAL`; changed loop body to `if (!iaa_compression_modes[i]) return i;` without `continue`/`break`; moved `return -EINVAL` to after the loop.
intent_record.how: The function now returns the first empty slot index upon finding one, and returns -EINVAL only after exhausting all slots. Previously, it would incorrectly return the array size (`IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX`) when all slots were occupied, instead of a negative error code.

grouping_result.intent: Fix incorrect return value when no empty compression mode slot is available, ensuring a proper error code is returned.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly fixes the root cause by changing the return value from the loop boundary (which leads to out-of-bounds access) to a proper error code.

candidates.rationale: The function returns the loop counter i after the loop completes, which equals IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX when no empty slot is found, leading to an out-of-bounds array access when used as an index.

vuln_statements.explanation: When the loop completes without finding an empty slot, 'i' equals 'IAA_COMP_MODES_MAX', which is returned instead of an error. This causes an out-of-bounds array access when the return value is used as an index.
